boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University at Albany
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe campus food stops with Fall 2026 hours publicly posted by University Auxiliary Services; schedules take effect August 24 and may change during breaks or emergencies.

cards.title: Indigenous Quad Dining
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus · late dinner through 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Use this residential dining room for a late dinner Monday through Thursday; check the University schedule again before heading over during breaks.
cards.short_summary: A campus late-dinner option on Indigenous Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Late Dinner at Indigenous Quad from 8 to 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: late dinner runs 8–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 8–10 p.m. Sunday; hours may change.

cards.title: State Quad Dining
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus · late dinner through 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Plan a Monday-through-Thursday late dinner here, then confirm the posted schedule if a holiday, recess, or weather event affects service.
cards.short_summary: A second residential late-dinner stop on Uptown Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Late Dinner at State Quad from 8 to 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: late dinner runs 8–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 8–10 p.m. Sunday; hours may change.

cards.title: District East
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus · dinner through 10:30 p.m.
cards.notes: For a later campus meal, use District East’s posted dinner window; it runs every day in the Fall 2026 schedule.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day campus dining option with an evening window.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists District East dinner from 4 to 10:30 p.m. Monday through Friday and Saturday through Sunday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: dinner is posted until 10:30 p.m. daily; hours may change.

cards.title: Baba's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open as late as 10:30 p.m.
cards.notes: Check Baba’s posted day-by-day hours before a Campus Center stop; Friday and Saturday have the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: Campus Center pizza with late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Baba's Pizza open until 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: closes 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday, 10:30 p.m. Friday, and 10:30 p.m. Saturday.

cards.title: Jamal's Chicken
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open as late as 10:30 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center listing to time a Jamal’s Chicken visit; Friday and Saturday are posted later than the other days.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center food counter with late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Jamal's Chicken open until 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: noon–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and noon–10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: The Halal Shack
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open through 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Make this a later Campus Center meal stop when its published 10 p.m. closing fits your schedule; verify hours around University recesses.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center option listed through 10 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists The Halal Shack open until 10 p.m. Monday through Friday and Saturday through Sunday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: posted noon–10 p.m. Saturday–Sunday and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday; hours may change.

cards.title: 518 Market
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open through 10 p.m. weekdays
cards.notes: Use 518 Market for an evening Campus Center purchase Monday through Friday, and check the shorter weekend window before going.
cards.short_summary: A weekday campus market open until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists 518 Market open from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday through Friday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays and 10 a.m.–7 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; hours may change.

cards.title: Nikos Café
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open through 8 p.m.
cards.notes: If you need an early-evening Campus Center food stop, use Nikos Café’s listed 8 p.m. closing time and verify special schedules first.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Nikos Café open until 8 p.m. Monday through Friday and Saturday through Sunday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: 10 a.m.–8 p.m. weekdays and noon–8 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; hours may change.

cards.title: Bento
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open through 8 p.m.
cards.notes: Fit Bento into an early-evening Campus Center plan; its posted schedule closes at 8 p.m. every day during the Fall term.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center counter with consistent 8 p.m. closing.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Bento open until 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Saturday through Sunday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: 11 a.m.–8 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 11 a.m.–6 p.m. Friday, and noon–8 p.m. weekends.

cards.title: Starbucks at Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Center · open through 8 p.m.
cards.notes: For an early-evening Campus Center stop, check Starbucks’ listed 8 p.m. closing and confirm the schedule before arriving during an academic break.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center counter open through 8 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Starbucks in the Campus Center open until 8 p.m. Monday through Friday and Saturday through Sunday for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 schedule is effective August 24: 8 a.m.–8 p.m. weekdays and 10 a.m.–8 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; hours may change.
